description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for Tiingo company news, including query parameters, data validation, and data extraction logic.

classes.name: TiingoCompanyNewsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Tiingo company news API, including symbol, date range, offset, and source.

classes.name: TiingoCompanyNewsData
classes.description: Represents individual news articles with fields like tags, article ID, source, and crawl date.

classes.name: TiingoCompanyNewsFetcher
classes.description: Handles transforming query parameters, fetching data asynchronously from Tiingo API, and transforming raw data into model instances.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts generic parameters dictionary into TiingoCompanyNewsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches news data from Tiingo API, handling pagination and errors.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API response data into list of TiingoCompanyNewsData instances.
